subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. U sits second to the right of R. Q sits second to the left of S. P is on the immediate left of Q. Who is sitting on the immediate left of T?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

U sits second to the right of R.

Q sits second to the left of S.

P is on the immediate left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ada9828b06d935c5be9621016a188829db898ef7b07f1cfe4731244d05f4b3d9.png] 

Here, U is sitting on the immediate left of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
